description: Make Printyx print shop management SaaS enterprise-grade, professional, and production-ready. Platform: React 18 + TypeScript + Express + PostgreSQL (Drizzle ORM) + Supabase. Architecture: multi-tenant 4-tier hierarchy (Platform > Company > Regional > Location), 8-level RBAC, 213 pages, 127 route files, 91 services, 51 schema files. Quality checks: npm run check (typecheck), npm run test (unit tests), npm run lint (eslint), npm run build (vite build).

Update the Database section in CLAUDE.md with new migration workflow replacing db:push references

Build passes: npm run build
userStories.notes: Currently using db:push which is not safe for production. Drizzle supports generate+migrate workflow. Main schema: shared/schema.ts (293KB) with 43 additional files in shared/*-schema.ts. Forecasting DB config: drizzle.forecasting.config.ts. See drizzle.config.ts for current setup.
